headline: Sources: Giants QB Jaxson Dart out for extended period
summary: Jaxson Dart's knee injury is more severe than originally anticipated, and the Giants QB could miss the rest of the season, sources told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport and Mike Garafolo.

headline: Report: Giants could re-sign Brandon Allen as their third QB
summary: With Jaxson Dart's injury worse than expected, Jameis Winston will become the Giants' starting quarterback.

headline: Packers Unsure If WR Jayden Reed Will Return This Season
summary: Packers head coach Matt LaFleur said on Tuesday (via ESPN’s Rob Demovsky) that it was “way too early” to make any prognostications about wide receiver Jayden Reed’s potential to return to the field this season. headline: Macdonald says Broncos' Payton accused Seahawks of cheating
summary: Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald says the Broncos wrongfully accused Seattle of a Spygate-like cheating scandal in 2024. Denver coach Sean Payton ultimately "backed off" after the Seahawks threatened a lawsuit if the Broncos went public with the allegation.

headline: A hit from the Texans popped Joe Burrow's rib back into place
summary: On Sunday, Bengals quarterback Joe Burrow took five sacks and 10 total hits against the Texans.
